evaluateus-dashboard-1.caption: The admin dashboard: active users, assessments, attempts, and the skills the AI scored.
evaluateus-dashboard-1.alt: EvaluateUs admin dashboard with an active users chart, cards for active assessments, users, attempts and creation, a bar chart of assessments created each day, and a skills pie chart.

evaluateus-list-1.caption: Assessment cards, tagged by type.
evaluateus-list-1.alt: A grid of assessment cards, each with an abstract thumbnail, a title such as "DoorDash: English language round", its status and date, and a Script or VoiceAI tag.

evaluateus-early-1.caption: Before: the first create flow, in a modal
evaluateus-early-1.alt: An early Create Assessment flow in a modal, with a dark side rail listing four steps and a form for title, type, welcome message and thumbnail.

evaluateus-early-dashboard-1.caption: An early dashboard, with numbers only. Later versions turned them into trends and skill breakdowns.
evaluateus-early-dashboard-1.alt: An early dashboard that shows assessments, metrics, candidates and skills as plain numbers.

evaluateus-wizard-script-1.caption: Each question gets its own time limit. The footer counts the questions as you add them.
evaluateus-wizard-script-1.alt: Create Assessment, Script step: four questions, each with its own time limit in minutes, and an Add Question button.

evaluateus-wizard-configure-1.caption: After: the full-page wizard
evaluateus-wizard-configure-1.alt: Create Assessment, Configure step: skills set by the admin shown in grey, settings for passcode, retakes and review, and anti-cheating options.

evaluateus-wizard-scope-1.caption: Scope by team structure: line of business, role, manager and teammates.
evaluateus-wizard-scope-1.alt: Create Assessment, Scoping step: dropdowns for line of business, role, manager and teammates, and a list of six candidates to select.

evaluateus-sent-1.caption: After sending, failed invitations get a Try Again button.
evaluateus-sent-1.alt: Sending summary: 10 questions, 10 recipients, 7 sent and 3 failed, with a Try Again button.

evaluateus-instructions-1.caption: Candidates see what they need, and agree to the rules, before the test starts.
evaluateus-instructions-1.alt: Candidate instructions for "DoorDash: English language round": what the candidate needs, how screen capture works, and a consent checkbox before Continue.

evaluateus-chat-1.caption: The candidate answers in a chat, with progress and time always in view.
evaluateus-chat-1.alt: A candidate taking a chat assessment: an AI question about a late food order, the candidate's reply, the next question, a progress bar at 2 of 10 and a timer.

evaluateus-review-1.caption: The AI shows its working: every mistake underlined, every correction listed by type.
evaluateus-review-1.alt: Assessor review: the candidate's answer with four mistakes underlined, a side panel listing each correction by type, and a skill breakdown.

evaluateus-stats-1.caption: Each assessment shows its candidates, their scores and levels, and a skills breakdown.
evaluateus-stats-1.alt: Assessment results: three candidates with their status, attempted share, score and level, a 67% completion ring and a skills pie chart.

evaluateus-config-1.caption: Skill weights add up to 100%. Allow Edit decides what a manager can change.
evaluateus-config-1.alt: Configuration: skill weights that add up to 100%, anti-cheating and settings with Allow Edit boxes, and a list of statistics the AI can report.

evaluateus-error-1.caption: An expired link gets a friendly page and one clear way back.
evaluateus-error-1.alt: An error page with an illustrated mailbox: "Oops! The link either expired or you don't have permission", and a Go Back button.

voiceai-scenarios-1.caption: Scenarios, each with a call type, an AI voice and a language.
voiceai-scenarios-1.alt: A scenarios list with two scenarios, "The Rainy Day" and "Sales follow-up call", showing call type, AI voice, language and who created each one.

voiceai-scenario-select-1.caption: The admin describes the situation in plain words, then tests it with Start Simulation.
voiceai-scenario-select-1.alt: Create Assessment, Scenario step: "The Rainy Day" picked, with tags for inbound call, voice and language, its setup text, and a Start Simulation button.

voiceai-simulation-1.caption: A test call: the AI customer speaks, and the transcript builds live.
voiceai-simulation-1.alt: A test call: the scenario setup above a live transcript between the AI customer and the admin acting as the agent, with Restart and Duplicate and Edit buttons.

voiceai-configure-1.caption: For a mock call, the skills become the parts of a good call.
voiceai-configure-1.alt: Configure step for a mock call: call-handling skills with weights that add up to 100%, anti-cheating options, and a setting to show the scenario during the call.

voiceai-call-1.caption: On the call, a status chip shows the AI's state.
voiceai-call-1.alt: A candidate on a mock call: the scenario, a Speaking status chip, the AI customer's first message, and Put on Hold and End Call buttons.

voiceai-call-2.caption: The candidate can put the customer on hold and resume, as they would on the floor.
voiceai-call-2.alt: The same mock call on hold: an On Hold status chip, three messages in the transcript, and Resume Call and End Call buttons.

voiceai-feedback-1.caption: The AI writes the evaluation questions from the scenario, then scores each one with a reason.
voiceai-feedback-1.alt: The Feedback by Question tab: three AI-written evaluation questions, each with a score out of 10 and one line on why, next to completion and skills charts.

voiceai-results-1.caption: Mock call results: three scores, the recording, the transcript, and coaching tips.
voiceai-results-1.alt: Mock Call Training Results: scores for communication, problem solving and customer empathy, a call recording timeline, the transcript with time stamps, a performance summary and coaching tips.

voiceai-dashboard-1.caption: One dashboard for both kinds of test, filtered by product type.
voiceai-dashboard-1.alt: An analytics dashboard filtered to EvaluateUs: assessment adoption and creation charts, cards for assessments, users, scripts and attempts, and a skills pie chart.
